description: REF, decided when the formula is defined (ADR-0076, item 10). REF() is the pointer to the document the formula belongs to and stands where ID() may; REF(class, id) names its class as a text, a class the database has, and takes any text for the id. The compiler knows the class each pointer points at: the suite's formulas belong to a Customer, order points at an Order, customer at a Customer, and what other points at is not known. A comparison of pointers to two classes is refused, in the formula and in the condition of a LOOKUP alike; a pointer never compares with a text.
